searches.title: Search Queries
searches.description: List of searches to perform. Each item needs a 'what' (category) and 'where' (city/province).

what.title: Category / Business Type
what.description: What to search for (e.g. ristoranti, avvocati, idraulici)

where.title: City / Province
where.description: Where to search (e.g. napoli, milano, roma)

maxResults.title: Max Results per Search
maxResults.description: Maximum number of listings to extract per search query.

onlyWithPhone.title: Only listings with phone number
onlyWithPhone.description: Filter out listings that don't have a phone number.

onlyWithWebsite.title: Only listings with website
onlyWithWebsite.description: Filter out listings that don't have a website.

onlyWithEmail.title: Only listings with email
onlyWithEmail.description: Filter out listings that don't have an email address.

useApifyProxy.title: Use Apify Proxy
useApifyProxy.description: Use Apify residential proxies to avoid blocks. Strongly recommended.

proxyCountry.title: Proxy Country
proxyCountry.description: Country code for proxy. Use IT for Italian residential IPs.
